answer: The jade is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the cipher. By the falcon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
